extra_vyplata_premium_nov_2026.details: No November 2026 Extra vyplata premium decision exists. The only Extra vyplata decision listed is for October 2026 (1.10-29.10, 9 draws, tiers 3-8 x2, cap 550000 EUR, signed 25.08.2026, effective 26.08.2026). Actual Nov 2026 draws 2.11-19.11 paid tiers 3-8 = 0.309-0.314 of stakes, which is normal (premium months 0.624-0.626).

extra_vyplata_premium_dec_2026.details: No December decision on the herne-plany page. Guessed URLs (..._december_2026.pdf, ..._november_2026.pdf, ..._januar_2027.pdf under media/Documents/HernePlany and media/Stranky/2026) all return 404. Cannot be ruled out: game plan art. 35 only requires publication before the premium period, and the October decision came 5 weeks ahead. Base rate is low: since 2024-03 only May and Oct 2026 were premium months, and Dec 2024 and Dec 2025 were normal. Re-check the herne-plany page before the December draws.

notes: The decision PDFs are scans. They were read from PNG renders at 110 dpi; local copies are in the session scratchpad under premiums/ev_okt and premiums/pd_nov.
The task's 'tiers 3-5' means 3-5 matched numbers, which is prize ranks (poradie) 3-8 (5+1, 5+0, 4+1, 4+0, 3+1, 3+0). The October decision doubles exactly these ranks.
Normal tier quotas (percent of the prize fund): 1.5, 4.3, 4.4, 10.8, 6.2, 27.0. The October premium quotas were 3.0, 8.6, 8.8, 21.6, 12.4, 54.0.
